chunks: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth sings the praises of God. He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Tasbih al-Kull' (the universal glorification of all beings), suggesting that every entity, whether conscious or not, actively praises God in a manner suited to its nature. It underscores the harmony of creation under the absolute sovereignty of the Almighty and the Wise, reinforcing the theological principle that all existence is in a state of continuous submission and worship.
